cue: 整只脚踩上台阶，用上面那条腿的脚跟发力把身体推上去，后脚别蹬地借力。下来时慢慢放，膝盖对准第二、三脚趾，不要内扣。
cue_en: Put your whole foot on the step and drive through the heel of that top leg to lift yourself up; don't push off with the back foot. Lower slowly, keeping the knee tracking over your 2nd–3rd toes rather than caving in.

cue: 双脚略宽于肩、脚尖微外八，像往后坐椅子一样屁股先往后再往下，蹲到大腿接近平行地面。全程脚跟踩实、胸口朝前，起身时膝盖跟着脚尖方向走。
cue_en: Feet slightly wider than shoulders, toes turned out a little. Sit back as if onto a chair — hips back first, then down — until your thighs are about parallel to the floor. Keep heels planted and chest facing forward, and let your knees follow your toes as you stand up.

cue: 仰卧屈膝，脚跟离屁股约一个脚掌远，用脚跟蹬地把臀部抬到肩、髋、膝成一条直线。顶端夹紧臀部停 1 秒，别靠挺腰把肚子往上顶。
cue_en: Lie on your back with knees bent, heels about one foot-length from your butt. Push through your heels to lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line. Squeeze your glutes at the top for 1 second — don't arch your lower back to push your belly up.

cue: 双手与肩同宽握带，手臂伸直举到胸前，向两侧拉开直到弹力带碰到胸口，感觉两块肩胛骨往中间夹。肩膀往下沉、别耸肩，回程慢慢放。
cue_en: Hold the band with hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight out in front at chest height. Pull it apart until the band touches your chest, feeling your shoulder blades squeeze together. Keep shoulders down (no shrugging) and return slowly.

cue: 双手捧住哑铃一端贴在胸前，肘尖朝下；脚跟踩实，蹲到大腿平行地面，肘部落在两膝之间。起身时用整只脚蹬地，上身保持挺直不前倾。
cue_en: Cup one end of the dumbbell with both hands against your chest, elbows pointing down. Keep heels planted and squat until thighs are parallel to the floor, elbows landing between your knees. Drive up through your whole foot, keeping your torso upright rather than tipping forward.

cue: 双手略宽于肩，收紧腹部和臀部让头到脚跟成一条直线，下降时手肘向后斜 45 度、胸口接近地面再推起。做不了标准的就把手撑在凳子上降低难度，别塌腰。
cue_en: Hands slightly wider than shoulders; brace your abs and glutes so your body is a straight line from head to heels. Lower with elbows angled back about 45°, chest close to the floor, then push up. If a full push-up is too hard, put your hands on a bench to make it easier — just don't let your hips sag.

cue: 握住把手身体后倾，全身绷直像一块板，用手肘往后拉把胸口拉向把手，顶端夹紧肩胛骨。脚越往前站越难，屁股不要往下坠。
cue_en: Hold the handles and lean back with your whole body rigid like a plank. Pull your elbows back to bring your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades at the top. The further forward your feet, the harder it gets — don't let your hips drop.

cue: 膝盖微屈固定不动，屁股往后推、上身前倾，哑铃贴着大腿往下滑到小腿中段或大腿后侧有明显拉伸感为止。全程背部平直不弓背，起身时夹臀把髋往前推。
cue_en: Keep a slight, fixed bend in your knees. Push your hips back and lean forward, sliding the dumbbells down your thighs until they reach mid-shin or you feel a clear stretch in your hamstrings. Keep your back flat the whole time (no rounding), and squeeze your glutes to drive your hips forward as you stand up.

cue: 站在龙门架中间、一脚在前，手肘微屈固定角度，从高处往身体前下方画弧把两手合拢，可以让双手轻轻交叉。感觉胸口在挤压，回程慢慢让手打开到胸部有拉伸感。
cue_en: Stand in the middle of the cable machine with one foot forward, elbows slightly bent and locked at that angle. Sweep your hands from high to low in an arc in front of your body until they meet — you can let them cross slightly. Feel your chest squeeze, then slowly let your hands open until you feel a stretch across your chest.

cue: 滑轮调到大约胸口高度，手肘微屈像抱一棵大树，双手在胸前正中合拢。动作靠胸发力，手肘角度不变，别变成用手臂推。
cue_en: Set the pulleys at about chest height. With a slight bend in the elbows, as if hugging a big tree, bring your hands together in front of the middle of your chest. Let your chest do the work and keep the elbow angle fixed — don't turn it into a pressing motion with your arms.

cue: 单膝跪地，持哑铃那一侧的膝盖着地，收紧臀部和腹部让上身直立不后仰。哑铃从肩旁垂直推到头顶，手臂伸直后慢慢放回肩部。
cue_en: Kneel on one knee, with the knee on the same side as the dumbbell on the floor. Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your torso stays upright without leaning back. Press the dumbbell straight up from beside your shoulder to overhead, then slowly lower it back to the shoulder once your arm is straight.

cue: 两手各提一只哑铃垂在身体两侧，握紧、肩膀往下沉往后收，站直挺胸。小步稳稳往前走，身体不左右摇晃。
cue_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a tight grip. Pull your shoulders down and back, and stand tall with your chest up. Walk forward with short, steady steps, without swaying side to side.

cue: 右脚向前迈成大弓步，左手撑地，右肘向下贴近右脚内侧，再把右手向天花板打开、眼睛跟着手转。最后双手撑地、前腿伸直感受大腿后侧拉伸，换边重复。
cue_en: Step your right foot forward into a deep lunge and place your left hand on the floor. Drop your right elbow down toward the inside of your right foot, then reach your right hand up to the ceiling and follow it with your eyes. Finish with both hands on the floor and straighten the front leg to stretch the back of the thigh, then switch sides.

cue: 仰卧，双手指向天花板，髋膝都屈成 90 度，下背压紧地面。慢慢伸出对侧手和脚接近地面再收回，换边；下背一离地就是伸太远了。
cue_en: Lie on your back with arms pointing at the ceiling and hips and knees bent to 90°, lower back pressed into the floor. Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg toward the floor, then bring them back and switch sides. If your lower back lifts off the floor, you've reached too far.

cue: 两手提哑铃站直，一只脚向后迈一大步，下蹲到后膝快碰地、前膝约 90 度。用前脚脚跟发力站回起始位置，上身保持直立。
cue_en: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand. Take a big step back with one foot and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor and the front knee is at about 90°. Push through the front heel to return to standing, keeping your torso upright.

cue: 躺在凳上双脚踩实地面，肩胛骨往后往下收紧贴凳。哑铃下放到胸口两侧、前臂垂直地面，手肘与身体约 45 至 60 度，再向上推到两只哑铃接近。
cue_en: Lie on the bench with feet flat on the floor, shoulder blades pulled back and down into the bench. Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest with forearms vertical and elbows about 45–60° from your body, then press up until the dumbbells nearly touch.

cue: 侧对龙门架站好，双手握把手贴在胸口，绳子从侧面拉着你。收紧腹部把双手向正前方推直，停 1 到 2 秒再收回，全程身体不要被拉得转过去。
cue_en: Stand side-on to the cable machine holding the handle against your chest, with the cable pulling from the side. Brace your abs and press your hands straight out in front, hold 1–2 seconds, then bring them back. Don't let the cable twist your body toward it at any point.

cue: 面对龙门架站直，大臂贴紧身体两侧不动，只靠前臂把把手往下压到手臂完全伸直。回程慢慢让前臂抬到约与地面平行，肘部不要往前跑。
cue_en: Stand tall facing the cable machine with your upper arms pinned to your sides. Using only your forearms, push the handle down until your arms are fully straight. Return slowly until your forearms are about parallel to the floor, without letting your elbows drift forward.

cue: 站直，手心朝前，大臂夹在身体两侧不动，弯曲手肘把哑铃举到肩前。下放要慢，别用身体前后晃借力。
cue_en: Stand tall, palms facing forward, upper arms tucked against your sides and kept still. Bend your elbows to curl the dumbbells up to the front of your shoulders. Lower slowly and don't swing your body to help.

cue: 具体动作待和教练确认。不论做哪种瑞士球动作，都先收紧腹部、保持骨盆稳定，动作慢而受控，球滚动时身体不要晃。
cue_en: Exact exercise still to be confirmed with the trainer. Whatever the stability-ball move, brace your abs first and keep your pelvis steady; move slowly and with control, and don't let your body wobble as the ball rolls.

cue: 双脚与肩同宽站稳，收紧臀部和腹部，哑铃举在肩旁、手心朝前。向上推到手臂伸直，别挺腰后仰，再慢慢放回耳朵高度。
cue_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, glutes and abs tight, dumbbells at your shoulders with palms facing forward. Press up until your arms are straight without arching your back or leaning back, then slowly lower to about ear height.

cue: 手肘在肩膀正下方撑地，夹紧臀部、肚脐往里收，让头、背、臀、脚跟成一条直线。不塌腰也不撅屁股，保持正常呼吸。
cue_en: Rest on your forearms with elbows directly under your shoulders. Squeeze your glutes and draw your belly button in so your head, back, hips and heels form a straight line. Don't let your hips sag or pike up, and keep breathing normally.

cue: 两手提哑铃垂在身体两侧，整只脚踩上台阶，用前腿脚跟发力站上去、站直后再慢慢下来。上身微前倾但保持背部挺直，膝盖不要内扣。
cue_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Put your whole foot on the step and drive through the front heel to stand up fully, then step down slowly. Lean slightly forward but keep your back straight, and don't let your knee cave in.

cue: 弹力带套在膝盖上方，半蹲、膝盖始终向外顶住带子。向侧面迈小步，两脚不要并拢，上身不左右晃，走完一边换方向。
cue_en: Loop the band just above your knees, sit into a half squat and keep pushing your knees out against the band. Take small steps to the side without letting your feet come together or your upper body sway, then switch direction.

cue: 凳子调到约 30°（太高就变成练肩），躺好后双脚踩实地面，肩胛骨往后收、往下沉贴紧凳面。哑铃下放到上胸两侧、前臂垂直地面，再向上推到锁骨正上方，两只哑铃接近但不相撞，全程肩胛骨保持收紧。
cue_en: Set the bench to about 30° (any steeper and it turns into a shoulder exercise). Lie back with feet flat on the floor and pull your shoulder blades back and down into the bench. Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest with forearms vertical, then press up until they're directly above your collarbones, close together but not clanking — keep your shoulder blades pinned the whole time.

cue: 调好护膝垫把大腿压住，双手正握、握距比肩宽一拳左右。先把肩膀往下沉，再用手肘往下、往后拉，把横杆拉到锁骨附近，顶端停 1 秒感受背部发力；上身最多后仰约 15°，别靠甩身体往下拉，回程慢慢让手臂伸直。
cue_en: Adjust the knee pad so it holds your thighs down. Take an overhand grip about a fist's width wider than your shoulders on each side. First pull your shoulders down, then drive your elbows down and back to bring the bar to about collarbone level; pause 1 second at the bottom and feel your back working. Lean back no more than about 15° — don't swing your body to yank the bar down — and let your arms straighten slowly on the way up.

cue: 跪坐在脚跟上，上身向前趴下、额头贴地，双臂向前伸直，呼气时让臀部往脚跟沉、双手再往前够一点。腋下到背部两侧和下背应有拉伸感；常见错误是臀部翘离脚跟、只把手往前伸，这样背部几乎拉不到。
cue_en: Sit back on your heels, fold your torso forward with your forehead on the floor and arms reaching straight out in front. Each time you exhale, let your hips sink toward your heels and reach your hands a little further. You should feel the stretch from your armpits down the sides of your back and in your lower back. Common mistake: letting your hips lift off your heels and only reaching with the hands — then your back barely stretches.

cue: 站直，一只手臂举过头、弯曲手肘让手落在脑后，另一只手抓住这只手的肘部，慢慢往内下方拉。大臂后侧（肱三头肌）到腋下应有拉伸感；常见错误是为了拉得更深而挺腰、头往前探，保持腹部收紧、头正对前方。
cue_en: Stand tall, raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head. With the other hand, hold that elbow and gently pull it inward and down. You should feel the stretch along the back of the upper arm (triceps) down into the armpit. Common mistake: arching your lower back or pushing your head forward to go deeper — keep your abs braced and your head facing straight ahead.

cue: 侧躺，下面的腿伸直、上面的腿屈膝让膝盖贴地，双手在胸前伸直合掌；上面的手像翻书一样画弧打开到身体另一侧，头和眼睛跟着手转，停 2 到 3 秒再慢慢合上。胸前和上背、腰侧应有转开的拉伸感；常见错误是上面的膝盖跟着离地，那样扭的是腰不是胸椎，膝盖要一直压在地上。
cue_en: Lie on your side with the bottom leg straight and the top leg bent so its knee rests on the floor; arms straight out in front of your chest, palms together. Sweep the top hand up and over in an arc like opening a book until it reaches the floor on the other side, turning your head and eyes to follow it. Hold 2–3 seconds, then close slowly. You should feel the stretch opening across your chest, upper back and the side of your waist. Common mistake: letting the top knee lift off the floor — then you're twisting your lower back instead of your upper spine, so keep that knee pinned down.

cue: 站在门框或立柱旁，前臂和手掌贴住立柱、肘与肩同高，同侧脚向前迈一小步，身体慢慢往前倾，直到胸前和肩前有拉伸感，保持后换边。常见错误是耸肩或肘抬得比肩高，肩膀要往下沉，不应感到肩关节刺痛。
cue_en: Stand next to a doorframe or rack upright, forearm and palm flat against it with your elbow at shoulder height. Step forward a little with the same-side foot and slowly lean your body forward until you feel a stretch across the front of your chest and shoulder; hold, then switch sides. Common mistake: shrugging or letting the elbow ride above shoulder height — keep your shoulder down, and you should never feel a sharp pain in the shoulder joint.
